description: Spec 018 re-score (SRD Annex C §C.13, C.5: one re-score of the same frozen multipliers on a larger fresh seed): the fused tracker's calibrated uncertainty, decision 33's tracker, reference and multipliers unchanged, judged at G7 on fresh seed 216 (1,100,000; its 110,000-scenario test split, generated alone, sized by the G7 panel so that a ±0.3 pp coverage interval is reachable). Nothing is trained or refitted.
